# motherduck_role_grant (Resource)

Grants one MotherDuck role directly to a user or another role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "motherduck_role" "analytics_readers" {
  name = "analytics_readers"
}

resource "motherduck_role_grant" "service_account" {
  role_name    = motherduck_role.analytics_readers.name
  grantee_name = "svc_analytics_reader"
  grantee_type = "user"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grantee_name` (String) User, service-account, or role principal receiving the role.
- `role_name` (String) Role to grant. Uses the lowercase MotherDuck role-name form: 3 to 255 characters, starting with a letter, containing only letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.

### Optional

- `grantee_type` (String) Principal type: `user` or `role`. Defaults to `user`.

### Read-Only

- `granted_at` (String) Grant creation timestamp reported by MotherDuck.
- `id` (String) Role grant ID in `<role_name>/<grantee_type>/<grantee_name>` form.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import motherduck_role_grant.service_account analytics_readers/user/svc_analytics_reader
```
